places.quote: got out of the coach a little way short of Reading
places.note: The coach passes near Reading on the way to London.

places.quote: the uncertain and the unreal air of everything at Greenleaf (Miss Donny’s house)
places.note: Fictional school; its location is not given, though it is near Reading.

places.quote: I am from Kenge and Carboy’s, miss, of Lincoln’s Inn.
places.note: Letterhead also gives Old Square, Lincoln's Inn.

places.quote: to White Horse Cellar, Piccadilly, London
places.note: Coach terminus named in the letter; the arrival is implied there.

places.quote: to White Horse Cellar, Piccadilly, London
places.note: Appears only in the address of White Horse Cellar.
